entries.name: types
entries.description:
MDAST node types to be scanned as a content block.

If a node's type is listed in this array, it will be converted into a single content block.

entries.name: stringify
entries.description: stringify text content from a MDAST node.

entries.name: mdxTypes
entries.description:
Whether the MDX element should be treated as a single content block, only effective if `types` has `mdxJsxFlowElement`.

Default: return `true` if the element is a leaf node, otherwise `false`.

entries.name: allowedMdxAttributes
entries.type: string[] | ((node: MdxJsxFlowElement | MdxJsxTextElement, attribute: MdxJsxAttribute | MdxJsxExpressionAttribute) => boolean) | undefined

entries.name: exportAs
entries.description: export as `structuredData` (if true) or specified variable name.
